authority.instruction: The optimizer is not optimizing while managed automations are stopped; repair it so it actually optimizes and keeps the full pool working.
supersedes_method_only: re-enable-only as the sole scheduler strategy
the prior self-imposed prohibition on changing managed schedules or optimizer cadence when such changes are needed to keep all existing roles active
does_not_change: the zero finite monthly/trial/paid quota requirement
primary O authority, lease, fence, frozen request, protected state or merge authority

problem.observed_pattern: At least four times, roles with enabled_desired=true and nonempty Phase-1 continuations became physically disabled after an invocation. Re-enabling restored 19/19 only temporarily.
problem.why_prior_method_failed: Hourly reactive re-enable restores the pool after loss but leaves workers stopped for material intervals and does not remove or route around the lifecycle failure. That is recovery, not optimization.

optimizer_execution_order: Read live physical automation state before semantic optimization.
Re-enable every stopped intended enabled_desired role on the same task id and read back is_enabled=true.
Apply or verify the persistence schedule plan below.
Record exact before/after task ids, schedules, timing modes, last_run, updated_at and enabled readback.
Only then perform the full role-and-method allocation optimization for the Phase-1 root.

selected_plan.name: staggered_existing_pool_plus_frequent_lightweight_optimizer_guard
selected_plan.selection_reason: The current clean-worker minute-0 cluster and once-hourly reconciliation maximize simultaneous queueing and downtime after lifecycle drift. Staggering keeps all existing roles, reduces collisions, and frequent guard slots bound stopped time without adding tasks.

optimizer_task.guard_rule: Guard slots must not rerun the heavy semantic portfolio when controls/receipts/frontier are unchanged. They inspect live state, repair stopped intended roles, persist a compact receipt, and exit with the optimizer still enabled.

selected_plan.application_rule: Update schedules on the same existing task ids only. Do not change worker prompts or substantive role assignments as part of scheduler optimization. Re-read every updated task. If an update fails, keep that task enabled on its prior schedule, record the exact failure, and continue repairing all others; never disable another task to compensate.
selected_plan.rollback: If the staggered map produces a lower successful-slot rate than the prior map across matched evidence, restore the exact preserved prior schedules while keeping all roles enabled, then test the next alternative. Rollback never means pool reduction.

alternatives_and_switching.alternative_1: Optimizer guard cadence only, worker schedules unchanged.
alternatives_and_switching.alternative_2: Staggered worker map plus guard cadence (selected).
alternatives_and_switching.alternative_3: If post-invocation disable persists after staggering, test timing_mode=condition_watch on one non-primary canary role while retaining its recurring schedule and all safety/continuation contracts.
alternatives_and_switching.alternative_4: If timing mode is not causal, test a repository-defined terminal/noncompletion method variant on one canary; never invent a completion claim or self-disable action.
alternatives_and_switching.switch_rule: Compare successful scheduled-slot coverage, physically enabled survival, useful output, duplicate/conflict rate, optimizer overhead and time-to-Phase-1 root. Switch only when expected time-to-root improves. Preserve all evidence from rejected variants.

persistence_acceptance.minimum_observation: Every intended role remains physically enabled through two consecutive scheduled invocation boundaries under the applied schedule, with exact later live readback.
persistence_acceptance.failure_action: Capture the exact terminal receipt and platform boundary, re-enable the same task immediately, keep the root open, and test the next causal alternative. Do not call repeated re-enable alone a solved optimization.

role_optimization_continues.phase1: After each physical guard, allocate all 19 roles across the highest-value non-conflicting unresolved Phase-1 leaves and optimize the solving method, not merely role names.
role_optimization_continues.phase2: Only after valid Phase-1 closure, use the full pool to minimize expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective.

exact_next_action: At the next optimizer execution, inspect live physical state; re-enable every stopped intended role with readback; update the optimizer's own schedule to the five guard/full slots; apply the deterministic same-task staggered map; read back all 19 roles and the protected monitor; write a compact application receipt; then perform the full Phase-1 role-and-method optimization. Do not merely write another 19/19 snapshot and wait for the next drift.
